text:
Hi,

I'm currently 38 weeks pregnant with my second child, and we're having some difficulties with Bituach Leumi regarding form בל/300 (מענק אשפוז/לידה). I've been on an A5 visa for four years and recently applied for citizenship.

My official due date is 9 July, and we submitted the request about two weeks ago. However, it was rejected because, according to Bituach Leumi, they can only issue the document during the month of the due date. That wouldn't be a problem if my due date were at the end of the month, but it's right at the beginning.

Two years ago, they issued the document without any problems when I was 36 weeks pregnant (it was the beginning of July, and my due date was at the beginning of August).

My husband called Bituach Leumi, and the clerk told him that she doesn't know what happened two years ago, but that the current policy is to issue the document only during the month of the due date (good luck to anyone whose due date is on the 1st or 2nd of the month...). She said that when the time comes and we need to go to the hospital, we can call them and they will issue the form on the spot.

We called again because I started wondering what would happen if I needed to go to the hospital at night, on Friday, or on Shabbat. They don't work during those times, so nobody would be available to help us. Another clerk said that she had submitted a request in the system so that someone would call us back either today or on Sunday. Which means that if I go into labour this weekend, we're basically not covered.

Does anyone know what we're supposed to do in this situation? It's very stressful, especially this late in the pregnancy. My first child was born several days before the due date, which only adds to the stress.

Has anyone dealt with this recently? What's going on with Bituach Leumi, and why are they refusing to issue this document any earlier?

Thank you so much!
